title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (B)

questions.stem: What is a key advantage of anaerobic respiration over aerobic respiration?

options.text: It occurs in more types of cells
It can release energy when oxygen is unavailable

questions.explanation: The main advantage of anaerobic respiration is that it can release energy without oxygen. This is essential during intense exercise when oxygen supply cannot meet demand.
